title: AI SDLC machine profile
description: Facts about one person on one machine. Lives at profile.json in the AI SDLC home (AI_SDLC_HOME, default ~/.ai-sdlc). Never committed. Holds names and settings only, never credentials.

ownerName.description: The person the skills call "the owner".

crossModelReviewAuthorized.description: Whether plans and code may be sent to additional model providers for critique and review.

sharedResources.description: Local services, databases, ports, or hosts that parallel stories must not fight over.

defaultVerificationEnvironment.description: Where before-and-after and live tests run by default.

declinedComponents.description: Optional components the owner chose not to install, such as hyperframes or ffmpeg, so the check stops raising them.

repos.description: The owner's profile for each repository, keyed by owner/name.
